scope: Direct deterministic-control to Wan robot-factored pilot for unscrewing
summary: The 125-frame direct-control pilot failed closed during Wan preprocessing because SAM2 produced an empty subject mask on a line-art control frame; no generative candidate was produced or promoted.
evidence: The metadata records failed status and the exact zero-size mask traceback from Wan preprocessing.
The driver preprocessing log completes propagation and then fails in get_mask_boxes before generation.
lessons: Explicit line-art controls are adequate for H3 conditioning but are not guaranteed to satisfy Wan's realistic-subject segmentation precondition.
limitations: This negative probe does not evaluate video quality because generation never started.
next_actions: Generate realistic H3 robot-action drivers first, then reuse the previously accepted Wan robot-factored route.
